title: Zenith Crisp Syrian Avocado Tagine
description: A bitter, crisp, and comforting Syrian dish featuring avocado hass pulp, deglaze, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the sumac, pomegranate molasses, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chickpeas and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the avocado hass pulp and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Deglaze the tagine with a little water if the sauce is too thick.
